verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an open-source self-hosted bundle (REST API + dashboard, per-user API keys, audit log) explicitly designed to run on infrastructure the platform-engineer controls, and a runtime probe confirms the underlying OSS SDK (mem0ai) is genuinely pip-installable and importable without any hosted API key, corroborating that the self-host path is real rather than just marketing copy. Missing for 10: an independent/hands-on confirmation of the actual Docker stack running end-to-end (docker-compose up, dashboard reachable) rather than just the pip SDK import, and any third-party report of self-hosting experience.
